card.name: First digit of dose numbers
card.fires_on: The first digit (or a piece) of a number that begins a dose, rate, strength or field value, most often right after a table cell, range or parenthesis. Typical examples are 1 in 10 million units and 3 in 3.375 g.

modes.label: Leading digit of a dose
modes.description: The first digit of a dose or rate figure such as units per day, grams or mg.

modes.description: A leading digit in a field strength or measurement such as MRI tesla values.
